scope: Coherent file-page-cache workingset classification plus PSI refault waits; root agent owns block submission instrumentation. Anonymous/swap workingset extension is separately mapped, not claimed implemented.

source_commits.title: mm: workingset: don't drop refault information prematurely
mm: workingset: tell cache transitions from workingset thrashing
psi: pressure stall information for CPU, memory, and IO

adaptations: Append PG_workingset immediately before __NR_PAGEFLAGS instead of upstream insertion/reordering. Selected BCM config assigns bit 21; every old enum value is retained. Rebuild generated bounds.h before ABI probe.

Do not add WORKINGSET_RESTORE diagnostic counter or modify node_stat_item. Existing values, NR_VM_NODE_STAT_ITEMS and embedded VM-stat array lengths are preserved. The counter does not drive PSI or refault decisions.

workingset_refault now accepts (page,shadow) and performs activation/restoration like upstream. It has no EXPORT_SYMBOL and is absent from the candidate Module.symvers; its only source caller is updated. No module-callable signature is replaced.

Do not apply original unconditional SetPageWorkingset(new_page) in swap_state.c. In the file-only stage, shrink_active_list marks only page_is_file_cache pages, and wait instrumentation explicitly excludes PageSwapBacked pages.
Import only PSI enter/leave from original filemap hook, not its separate delayacct/taskstats extension; this avoids enlarging task_delay_info and does not reduce PSI accounting.
Copy PG_workingset during migration and compound-page split. PAGE_FLAGS_CHECK_AT_PREP automatically includes the appended flag, and existing free_pages_prepare clears it before page reuse.

Keep existing 4.19 refault-distance algorithm and inactive_age layout. Shadow entries gain one private in-memory historical-active bit; no persistent storage format changes. Full-cache transition and cold reads are not automatically memory stalls.
semantic_path: File page becomes active through actual repeated access/refault.
When active file page is deactivated, set PageWorkingset.
On reclaim, pack historical-active bit into existing shadow entry alongside memcg/node/eviction timestamp.
On eligible refault within active_file distance, activate replacement page and restore PageWorkingset only if shadow says previously active.
Waiting for PG_locked on a not-yet-uptodate, non-swap-backed PageWorkingset page enters memory stall; completion and interrupted wait converge on the same leave.

verified_static_checks.existing_pageflag_values: enum text identical after removing appended flag
verified_static_checks.flag_reuse_cleanup: page_alloc.c clears PAGE_FLAGS_CHECK_AT_PREP on all inspected normal/compound free preparation paths

validation_not_claimed: Compiled page/zone/node flag and struct layout guard
remaining_scope: Anonymous/swap workingset detection and guarded swap_readpage/frontswap/zram PSI are not implemented here.
4.19 refault distance remains based on its existing local active-file LRU; later cross-cgroup/reclaim-root and file-versus-anon balancing algorithms are not silently imported.
No new workingset_restore statistic is exposed; PSI behavior does not require that statistic.

final_lifecycle_review.normal_and_compound_free: free_pages_prepare clears PAGE_FLAGS_CHECK_AT_PREP on head and constituent pages; appended flag is included in NR_PAGEFLAGS-generated mask.
final_lifecycle_review.migration: migrate_page_states explicitly copies PageWorkingset; old page is cleared by normal allocator recycle.
final_lifecycle_review.compound_split: __split_huge_page_tail includes PG_workingset in its copied flag mask before publishing the noncompound page.
final_lifecycle_review.page_cache_replacement: No extra field allocation or resource ownership is introduced; metadata remains within the page and existing refault shadow, and original upstream selected series does not require a new replacement destructor.
final_lifecycle_review.interrupted_wait: The only wait return occurs after finish_wait and conditional psi_memstall_leave. No PageWorkingset re-test on exit can accidentally skip leave.
final_lifecycle_review.swap_boundary: swap_state has no SetPageWorkingset; vmscan tag and filemap wait retain file-only guards until an anon-coherent extension exists.
final_lifecycle_review.validated_elsewhere: Root and test agent report full build and cold/hot A/B pass; ABI agent reports old field sizes/offsets/flag values preserved. Detailed validation belongs to their independently generated reports.
